sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies (NPCs). Decreases action speed by 60 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 30000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
